description: This file defines the interface and class for serial port communication within the WPEFramework Core namespace. It includes class declarations, enums for configuration parameters, and method signatures for managing serial port operations such as opening, closing, configuring, and data transfer.

classes.name: SerialPort
classes.description: Represents a serial port interface with methods for configuration, data transfer, and control, supporting both Windows and Unix-like systems.

methods.name: operator==
methods.description: Checks if two SerialPort instances refer to the same underlying descriptor.

methods.name: operator!=
methods.description: Checks if two SerialPort instances refer to different underlying descriptors.

methods.name: IsOpen
methods.description: Returns true if the serial port is currently open.

methods.name: IsClosed
methods.description: Returns true if the serial port is currently closed.

methods.name: HasError
methods.description: Returns true if the serial port has encountered an error.

methods.name: Flush
methods.description: Flushes the serial port buffers.

methods.name: LocalId
methods.description: Returns the local identifier (port name) of the serial port.

methods.name: RemoteId
methods.description: Returns the remote identifier (port name) of the serial port.

methods.name: Open
methods.description: Opens the serial port with a specified wait time.

methods.name: Close
methods.description: Closes the serial port with a specified wait time.

methods.name: Trigger
methods.description: Triggers an action on the serial port (implementation-specific).

methods.name: SendData
methods.description: Sends data through the serial port.

methods.name: ReceiveData
methods.description: Receives data from the serial port.

methods.name: StateChange
methods.description: Handles state change events for the serial port.

methods.name: Configuration
methods.description: Configures the serial port with detailed parameters.

methods.name: SetBaudRate
methods.description: Sets the baud rate of the serial port.

methods.name: SendBreak
methods.description: Sends a break signal on the serial port.

methods.name: Construct
methods.description: Initializes the serial port object with buffer sizes.

methods.name: Settings
methods.description: Applies the current configuration settings to the serial port.

methods.name: Opened
methods.description: Marks the serial port as opened and updates state.

methods.name: Closed
methods.description: Marks the serial port as closed and releases resources.

methods.name: WaitForClosure
methods.description: Waits for the serial port to close within a specified time.

methods.name: Write
methods.description: Writes data to the serial port (Windows/Linux).

methods.name: Read
methods.description: Reads data from the serial port (Windows/Linux).

methods.name: Descriptor
methods.description: Returns the handle or descriptor for the serial port (Linux).

methods.name: Events
methods.description: Returns the event mask for the serial port (Linux).

methods.name: Handle
methods.description: Handles events for the serial port (Linux).

methods.name: BufferAlignment
methods.description: Aligns the buffer for the descriptor (Linux/Windows).
